description: This file is a Markdown documentation describing how Thunder's subsystems framework works, including definitions, mechanisms for activating/deactivating subsystems, how to implement interfaces, plugin metadata, and notification handling within a Thunder-based project.

classes.name: InternetInfo
classes.description: An implementation of the IInternet interface used by plugins to provide internet status metadata, such as IP address and network type.

methods.name: InternetInfo()
methods.description: Constructor initializing default IP address and network type.

methods.name: PublicIPAddress()
methods.description: Returns the current public IP address; default is 'Unknown'.

methods.name: NetworkType()
methods.description: Returns the network type (UNKNOWN, IPV4, IPV6).
